baseline_source_revision: bf38cfd98 (root-provided audit baseline; no Git operation in this audit)
priority: Complete native16x24 sprite coverage across every biome and area before optional nuanced animation; ensure chunks feel intentionally composed rather than bare.
bounds: Source inventory and known integration seams only; no fresh Unity/gameplay acceptance earned by this ledger.
Raw definitions, PNG totals, surface coordinates and frame counts are not a completion percentage or unique sprite denominator.
Candidate identity lists are nonexhaustive source references, not guaranteed spawns. POIs and authored overlays can replace ordinary biome recipes.
Existing accepted opening and packaged receipts remain valid within their named bounds; do not reset them or promote them to complete regional coverage.
Unavailable/unaudited identity, state, held goods and generated variations remain explicit unknowns.
Normal projection/glyph fallback preserves playability but does not close a native-art coverage gap.

chunk_fullness_gate.requirement: Review whole playable chunks for coherent visual richness in actual1280x800 gameplay at1x/2x, not just individual sprite correctness.
checklist: Biome-specific ground/material variation supports the scene without indiscriminate noise.
Vegetation, rocks, structures and functional props form coherent clusters and transitions instead of uniform scatter or isolated samples.
Landmarks and secondary details create a recognizable area and avoid accidental large unfinished-looking gaps.
Traversal lanes, sightlines, target selection, hazards and interactable owners remain legible; decoration does not invent collision or services.
Adjacent chunks have continuity and meaningful formation differences; density is not copied identically everywhere.

Deliberately sparse areas such as Overwrit retain their authored identity, but still require explicit review of material, edge, landmark and route composition. Sparse is not a blanket visual-quality exemption.
If actual geometry must change, change the real generation/owner system under tests and preserve saves; never hide incomplete gameplay under a disconnected backdrop.
chunk_fullness_gate.prohibited_shortcut: No arbitrary entity-count target or random clutter fill can substitute for scene acceptance.
